notes: The ASV collapses הָאִשָּׁה הַמֻּכָּה הַמִּדְיָנִית into *the Midianitish woman that was slain*, writing one *the*: the first article takes it, the participle's article takes the relative *that* under rule 41, and the prenominal gentilic's article is unrepresented under rule 47.

אֻמּוֹת is absolute, so the *of* before *a fathers house* is the supplied appositional preposition rule 33 licenses on the nominal itself rather than rule 19's construct relation; the assignment is the same either way, and the unit note's rule 19 label is the only imprecision.
